phase_zero_acceptance: Registry bytes parsed and digested from one read, immutable loaded configuration owns both; do not bind newer disk digest to older parsed entries.

Changing registry before prepare rejects or reloads atomically; changing it after prepare rejects without CLI; fresh prepared-only configuration blocks without CLI; preserve original failing evidence.
Use fresh process or controlled immutable loader for each actual model request, with pinned source/input payload. Disk hashes before/after alone cannot certify loaded code identity.
Preserve image_chain_cli checkpoint NPZ, branch reasons, diagnostic PNG, model/native intent and historical profile refusal; raw-domain fields and unknown must survive serialization.
Static source closure must detect/refuse undeclared computed imports or require explicit capability extension. The observed 70-file current closure is not arbitrary-Python completeness.
Keep historical scientific manifests immutable; migration adds new current-run metadata instead of rewriting old source SHA/profile evidence.
Make missing source/input a typed blocked result. Frozen Python dataclasses and __all__ alone do not enforce all invariants against direct construction/import.
Native CPU/GPU success stays unavailable until exact native image identity/runtime input/target/rounding evidence exists; registry policy cannot manufacture that evidence.
not_measured: native pow or sqrt runtime coverage
